title: Error Signal Lattice and Quarantine Dashboard for cross-layer attribution
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Goal: build a unified visualization and pipeline that surfaces error signal relationships across transport (HTTP/gRPC), runtime (timeouts, cancellation, overload), and model layer (generation errors, decode failures, OOM) with an interactive quarantine mechanism that isolates correlated error clusters for triage.

Scope:
- A Grafana dashboard (Error Signal Lattice) that maps error dimensions (transport code, RPC code, timeout vs. server-side cancel, host, model_version, quantization profile, kernel selection) into an interactive lattice/heatmap so SREs can pivot by slice.
- A quarantine workflow that lets oncall mark clusters (by fingerprint) as quarantined: they are excluded from SLA burn calculations, get pinned to a temporary remediation policy (auto-retry/backoff/bypass-cache), and surface suggested mitigations.
- Tracehook and logs enrichment: add error_reason, model_variant, kv_cache_hit, kernel_tag to spans and logs upstream in the tracehook layer; propagate to metrics pipeline (prometheus labels + kafka event enrichment).
- Sampling & storage policy: high-fidelity traces for novel/unseen fingerprints, low-fidelity for known small-impact classes.
- Runbook integration: link quarantined clusters to runbooks and a GitHub issue template for follow-up.

Non-goals:
- Full automated remediation (this ticket only provides suggested actions).
- Changes to model serving runtime logic that require kernel changes; we will rely on existing telemetry available in hooks and host metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Grafana board "Error Signal Lattice" deployed to staging with interactive filters for transport code, model_version, host_pool, and quantized_profile
Tracehook enrichment implemented: spans include error_reason and model_variant tags for >95% of error traces in staging
Metrics pipeline emits an "error_fingerprint" label to OLAP and raw logs, and fingerprinting logic is documented
Quarantine action available in dashboard: mark/unmark fingerprint, assign mitigation tag, and link to runbook
SLO calculation excludes quarantined fingerprints within the staging preview and results validated against historical window
PRs merged for tracehook changes, metrics mapping, and Grafana dashboards; at least one internal demo runbook and GitHub issue template created
updates: 2025-03-12 Priya Shah: Ticket created after postmortem review of repeated model-rejection spikes. Initial scope agreed with SRE and ML infra.

2025-03-16 SRE review (Jordan Chen): recommended adding host_pool and kernel_tag to enrichments. Trade-off: slight increase in label cardinality; agreed to add kernel_tag only for error traces.
2025-03-17 Design review (Ava Mitchell): initial lattice layout accepted; requested ability to pin slices and quick export CSV for postmortem. Assigned to dashboard owner for follow-up.

2025-03-18 Diego Ramos: Metrics pipeline mapping implemented in kafka-topics -> enrichment service. Emitting error_fingerprint and quarantine_flag to topic observability.errors.v2. Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/obs-pipeline/pull/68

2025-03-19 Diego Ramos: Quarantine UX implemented in grafana using a writeback lambda (APIs protected by service-token). First end-to-end: mark fingerprint F-20250319-1 quarantined and confirmed excluded from SLO calculation in staging. Notified SREs for validation.
2025-03-20 Priya Shah: Demo scheduled for 2025-03-24 with SRE, ML infra, and PM. Need final signoff on sampling thresholds and CSV export feature scope.
